description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'CommonCommand' within a command framework related to the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality for command objects such as category management, type prefixes, and resource type information. The class is designed for immutability and is intended to be extended by concrete command implementations.

classes.name: CommonCommand
classes.description: Abstract base class for common commands, implementing core logic such as type prefix, resource type, category, and resource path.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix used for command types.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type identifier for common commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path, which is empty for this command.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type, superclass, and category.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper to ensure proper equality checks in inheritance hierarchy.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code considering superclass and category.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation including superclass info and category.
